title: Comparison of global cohomology
statement:
For a scheme $T$, finite $\Lambda$ and $K\in\Dplus(T_{\Et},\Lambda)$, the derived unit
induces a natural isomorphism

$$
 R\Gamma(T_{\Et},K)\xrightarrow{\sim}
 R\Gamma(T_{\Proet},\nu_T^*K).
$$

Both functors are ordinary derived sections.

proof.text: For a bounded-below complex J of pro-etale Λ-module sheaves, exactness of ν_T^* from [prop-weil-pbc-site-comparison-finite-level] implies that its right adjoint ν_{T,*} preserves injectives. Resolving J by injectives, ν_{T,*} computes the derived direct image, and evaluation on the final object identifies Γ(T_Et,ν_{T,*}J^r) with Γ(T_Proet,J^r) termwise. Therefore the derived-sections identity RΓ(T_Et,Rν_{T,*}J) ≅ RΓ(T_Proet,J) is the preceding node.

source.place: Proof, first paragraph through “Thus RΓ_Et Rν_{T,*}=RΓ_Proet.”

proof.text: Apply that identity to J=ν_T^*K. The derived unit K→Rν_{T,*}ν_T^*K is an isomorphism by [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison], so applying RΓ(T_Et,−) gives the claimed natural isomorphism RΓ(T_Et,K) ≅ RΓ(T_Proet,ν_T^*K).
